title: Finite representation cohomology of a constructible field complex
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $k^s/k$ a separable closure and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$ with its Krull topology. Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite normed extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A(P)=C(P,E)$ for every profinite set $P$, with pointwise operations [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Use $A_s=p_s^*A$, internal module objects and their ordinary derived categories [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{A_s})$ be bounded with cohomology constructible in the stratified local-finite-presentation sense [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Write $E_A:\operatorname{Mod}_{A_s}\simeq\mathcal A_G(A)$ for the normalized exact field/action equivalence [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport], with internal condensed action modules as in [def-sfb-condensed-action-module].

Every $H^q(M)$ is finite-rank lisse [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], and $D(E_A)M$ is bounded. For every integer $q$ there are a finite-dimensional norm-topological $E$-vector space $W_q$, a continuous $E$-linear $G$-action on it, and an isomorphism
$$H^q(D(E_A)M)\cong\bigl(P\mapsto C(P,W_q)\bigr)$$
in $\mathcal A_G(A)$. This identifies restrictions with precomposition and scalar multiplication and generalized $G$-actions with pointwise operations. There are integers $a\leq b$ such that $W_q=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. No bound on the arithmetic cohomological dimension of $k$ and no formation of $G$-invariants is required. The zero complex and $G=1$ are included.

proof.text: Fix $q$ and put $N=H^q(M)$. By [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] its constructibility means [def-sfb-constructible-module]. In any finite stratification of $s$, exactly one stratum has nonempty image, since $|s|$ has one point. Its immersion into $s$ is an isomorphism: an immersion factors through an open subscheme of $s$, necessarily $s$, and a nonempty closed subscheme of $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is $\operatorname{Spec}(k/0)=s$. Thus the local finite presentation on this stratum is local finite presentation on $s$. Explicitly, [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented] and [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module] give a pro-etale cover and finite cokernel diagrams $A_{U_i}^{m_i}\to A_{U_i}^{n_i}\to N|_{U_i}\to0$.

source.place: Definition 6.8.3; agent reduction of stratified local presentation on the one-point scheme

proof.text: Use [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] on the field site and its slices. It leaves the underlying abelian sheaves, section groups and restrictions identical; the regular module becomes the section ring module. An equivalence preserves finite sums and cokernels by their universal properties, so the diagrams in step 1 give precisely the local finite presentations required by [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-lfp-local-triviality]. Its coefficient is exactly $p_s^*C(-,E)=A_s$, and $|s|$ is Noetherian because its only opens are $\varnothing,s$. Apply that lemma with $X=s$: there is a pro-etale cover on which $N$ is finite free. Translate the resulting isomorphisms back to internal modules through the same equivalence. This is the lisse condition [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], including rank zero.

proof.text: The normalized equivalence $E_A$ of [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport] is exact and its derived equivalence is termwise. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] to this exact functor and a complex representing $M$. It gives $H^q(D(E_A)M)\cong E_A(H^q(M))$: kernels and images defining cohomology are carried to the corresponding kernels and images. Naturality in complexes makes this comparison invariant under quasi-isomorphisms, hence it is the comparison for the ordinary derived objects in the statement.

source.place: Tag 010N, lemma-exact-functor; exact functors preserve kernels and cokernels

proof.text: Apply the lisse restriction of [lem-sfb-field-action-derived-section-transport] to $N$ from step 2. It supplies a finite-dimensional norm-topological $E$-space $W_q$ with continuous linear $G$-action and $E_AN\cong C(-,W_q)$. For the operations clause use [lem-sfb-field-free-orbit-norm-lisse-reconstruction] for this same normalized presentation: it realizes variable group actions by $(g\cdot w)(p)=A(g(p))w(p)$, scalar multiplication pointwise, and test restrictions by precomposition. Its hypotheses hold because the normalized field equivalence evaluates on $\bar s[P]$ and forgetting its action is restriction to $\bar s$, as specified by the cited transport statement. Compose this isomorphism with that of step 3 in $\mathcal A_G(A)$.

source.place: Example 4.1.10; Definition 6.8.3; explicit norm-continuous reconstruction in the existing field/action nodes

proof.text: Choose $a\le b$ from boundedness in [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. For $q\notin[a,b]$, $H^q(M)=0$, so step 3 gives $H^q(D(E_A)M)=0$ because an exact additive equivalence preserves zero. Set $W_q=0$ with its unique action in these degrees, so $C(P,W_q)=0$ even for empty $P$. Choose the representations of step 4 only in the finitely many remaining degrees. The same $[a,b]$ bounds $D(E_A)M$. For $M=0$ take $a=b=0$ and all $W_q=0$; for $G=1$ the reconstruction has the trivial action. Only exact equivalence and lisse reconstruction were used, so neither taking invariants nor an arithmetic cohomological-dimension hypothesis enters.

lean.statement: theorem geometric_finite_cohomology_model (k ks : Type u) [Field k] [Field ks] [Algebra k ks] [IsSepClosure k ks] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] [CategoryTheory.CondensedBar.ActionAbelian (normCoefficients E) (ks ≃ₐ[k] ks)] (e : FieldData k ks (normCoefficients E)) (L : LisseTransport k ks E e) (M : DerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Modules (normCoefficients E).toMon (Spec (.of k)))) (hM : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj (normCoefficients E).X (Spec (.of k))) M) : (∀ q : ℤ, IsLisseCoefficientModule (normCoefficients E).X ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj M)) ∧ DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded ((fieldFunctor k ks e).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ∧ ∃ (a b : ℤ) (W : ℤ → NormContinuousRepresentations E (ks ≃ₐ[k] ks)), a ≤ b ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((fieldFunctor k ks e).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≅ (fieldFunctor k ks e).obj (L.equivalence.inverse.obj (W q)).obj)) ∧ ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → Subsingleton (W q).obj.V
lean.note: The chosen normalized field equivalence and its lisse realization are exposed as e and L from the recorded field-action transport system. The action-category isomorphism targets e(L.inverse(W_q)); L.sections, L.add, L.scalar, L.action and L.restriction identify this object exactly with P ↦ C(P,W_q), including every generalized scalar and group element. The existing general ring-object boundedConstructible predicate is used, not the discrete-coefficient specialization.
